name: Mineplex Games
description:
THE RETURN OF MINEPLEX 

Hello everyone!

A few years ago, Mineplex shut down with a promise that it would return. Today, we intend to fulfill that promise to you.

We are proud to announce that Mineplex is now under new ownership. Our team consists of passionate individuals who, like you, played Mineplex from its golden days all the way through to the end. Rest assured, we are equipped with the necessary tools and experience to revive what was once a treasure.

Our goal is to build a community-driven server packed with both classic and modern content. We truly believe that, with your help, we can restore Mineplex to being a competitor in the multiplayer scene. You heard that right - it will be returning as a Minecraft server, jumping straight into full release. The date and more information will be released soon!

Actions speak louder than words, and we will prove this to you.

Your new Mineplex Team
